thread.title: Bloomberg: Apple bringing subscriptions to TV app - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Bloomberg: Apple bringing subscriptions to TV app - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) will sell video service subscriptions through the TV app, according to Bloomberg sources .
The TV app aggregates content from providers that provide subscriptions like HBO or NBA League Pass. Currently, Apple sends the customer to the service provider to subscribe.
Offering in-TV subscriptions would essentially move the streaming content to Apple’s app, which could help the product compete against Amazon’s Channels program that offers subscriptions to HBO, Starz, and Showtime.
Apple shares are up 0.6% to $187.10.
